name: log-card-probe
description: Structured log, the probe harness of looks loaded from the card: at the first flush of a session (the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state) the flush task reads up to 2 KB of C:\EPM2LOOK.BIN (card_read). A file that starts with LKP1 holds a count, flags and records {u32 address, u16 length, u16 0, bytes, padded to 4}; a record is written (cached address and uncached alias) only when it lies inside one of the tables of the Pale&Light Color slot (Pro 400H: three tone tables, saturation pair, six-axis records, art matrix, chroma record), and card_rec logs each record (address, length | status << 16: 0 written, 1 refused). Flag bit 0 stores 0 into the IMG library's builder words 0xA07500B4 / 0xA07500B8 and 0xFF into the gamma states' art-code bytes, as the boot init does, so the look stages recompute. card_done gives the records written and the flags. Then the flush runs as before. In place of log-card-look, on the specs of data/builds/debug-log-films-12d.json. It puts the build id 368b6bae84a618c0 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/design.md section 8.
_ram: 1 byte of the log's state block (PST+104); the flush task's block buffer for the read

ops._note: hook (card_read): jmp T_CRD. the flush task's entry (log-core): `movm [d2,d3,a2,a3],(sp)` / `add -64,sp`; task USRTEST_A, started by T_GUI when the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 da49b2f5 -> 368b6bae (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 e7e62ca7 -> 84a618c0 (data/logdict/events.json)
